methodology: Seeded verified source stories; scheduled refresh expands from source feeds and sitemaps.

articles.title: AEP, Amazon and X-energy planning 12-SMR plant
articles.summary: American Electric Power and X-energy agreed to assess a 960 MW, 12-unit Xe-100 project in Indiana, with Amazon expected to support development and power offtake.

articles.title: Rosatom signs floating nuclear power deal for Indonesia
articles.summary: Rosatom and an Indonesian partner announced an electricity-supply arrangement for northern Halmahera using two proposed floating nuclear units with 200 MW of combined capacity.

articles.title: Joint venture to produce HALEU in South Africa
articles.summary: Quantum Leap Energy and South Africa's Necsa set out a proposed Pelindaba venture to develop test and commercial production of high-assay low-enriched uranium.

articles.title: Oklo plans isotope facility under US Launch Pad initiative
articles.summary: Oklo outlined plans for its Groves-2 Forge isotope production and processing pilot facility alongside its isotope-reactor development programme.

articles.title: Multiple milestones for India's nuclear projects
articles.summary: India reported progress on Kakrapar units 5 and 6, component manufacturing for fleet construction and a design milestone in its SMR programme.

articles.title: Mochovce 4 connected to the grid
articles.summary: Slovakia's Mochovce 4 began supplying electricity to the grid, marking a commissioning milestone.

articles.title: Norwegian used fuel to be stored in Sweden
articles.summary: Norwegian Nuclear Decommissioning selected Studsvik to manage and process used research-reactor fuel under an agreement running through 2055.

articles.title: Thorizon, TNO launch MSR materials programme
articles.summary: Thorizon and TNO launched corrosion and materials testing to support qualification and licensing of molten-salt reactor components.

articles.title: Milestone for Bruce 4 refurbishment
articles.summary: Bruce Power completed installation of 480 calandria tubes for the unit 4 refurbishment, progressing its major component replacement programme.

articles.title: Joint venture formed for six-unit SMR plant in Poland
articles.summary: SGE and ZE PAK agreed to create a venture for a potential 1,800 MW project at Pątnów comprising as many as six BWRX-300 reactors.

articles.title: US DOE funding to accelerate molten salt reactor development
articles.summary: US DOE approved cost-shared funding for the Molten Chloride Reactor Experiment, which is targeting first criticality in 2027.

articles.title: Newcleo opens MOX fuel development centre
articles.summary: Newcleo inaugurated a EUR10 million fuel engineering and testing centre in France to support its mixed-oxide fuel development work.

articles.title: MHI delivers replacement steam generators for French reactor
articles.summary: Mitsubishi Heavy Industries delivered three replacement steam generators intended for EDF's Cruas unit 2.

articles.title: Namibia takes step towards nuclear power
articles.summary: Namibia appointed a Nuclear Commissioner to coordinate the institutions and planning needed for a potential domestic nuclear power programme.

articles.title: Westinghouse places initial orders for Polish plant
articles.summary: Westinghouse issued conditional orders for safety-related AP1000 modules to four Polish companies, an early supply-chain milestone for Poland's first plant.

articles.title: Hot testing of Chinese SMR under way
articles.summary: Hot functional testing began at the ACP100/Linglong One small reactor demonstration project in Hainan, a pre-fuel-loading commissioning step.

articles.title: US maritime nuclear firm Bluecore Energy announces uranium purchase
articles.summary: Bluecore Energy announced acquisition of low-enriched uranium as it advances its maritime nuclear development plans.

articles.title: IAEA carries out fresh LTO review mission to Oskarshamn
articles.summary: The IAEA reviewed safety preparations for long-term operation at Sweden's Oskarshamn 3 reactor.

articles.title: Agreement aims to support US maritime nuclear
articles.summary: The American Bureau of Shipping and US DOE agreed to advance research and feasibility work on floating nuclear power and nuclear-powered shipping.

articles.title: Agreement signed on second Polish nuclear power plant
articles.summary: Polish state entities agreed on responsibilities for preparatory work for the country's proposed second nuclear power station.

articles.title: Czech SMR environmental impact assessment submitted
articles.summary: ČEZ submitted environmental impact documentation for a proposed Rolls-Royce SMR at Temelín, advancing the project's permitting process.

articles.title: NND applies to take over Kjeller nuclear facilities
articles.summary: Norwegian Nuclear Decommissioning applied for the licence to take responsibility for Kjeller research facilities ahead of decommissioning.

articles.title: Bangladesh's Rooppur 1 achieves criticality
articles.summary: Bangladesh's first commercial nuclear unit reached first criticality during commissioning.

articles.title: Milestone for Urenco USA expansion project
articles.summary: Urenco USA brought a sixth new enrichment cascade into production, reaching 75% completion of its current capacity addition.

articles.title: Hanhikivi-1 termination decision cases 'to continue'
articles.summary: Disputes surrounding the terminated Hanhikivi 1 nuclear project remain in arbitration and related proceedings.

articles.title: Poland begins ordering long-lead components for first AP1000
articles.summary: Poland advanced procurement of long-lead equipment for its planned first AP1000 nuclear project.

articles.title: China's Tianwan 7 connected to the grid
articles.summary: Unit 7 at China's Tianwan plant connected to the grid in another commissioning milestone.

articles.title: Duane Arnold restart underpins NextEra Energy and Google collaboration
articles.summary: NextEra and Google outlined a potential restart of Iowa's Duane Arnold plant and a 25-year power purchase arrangement.

articles.title: Google, Kairos Power, TVA announce collaboration
articles.summary: A proposed TVA power purchase arrangement would bring electricity from Kairos Power's Hermes 2 reactor to a grid serving Google facilities, targeting up to 50 MW.

articles.title: Second part of Palisades loan guarantee released
articles.summary: The US Department of Energy released further financing support for efforts to restart Michigan's Palisades plant.

articles.title: Three Mile Island restart project 'ahead of schedule'
articles.summary: Constellation reported early progress on preparations to restart Three Mile Island 1, renamed the Crane Clean Energy Center, under its Microsoft power deal.

articles.title: Amazon invests in X-energy, unveils SMR project plans
articles.summary: Amazon disclosed an investment in X-energy and plans for a multi-gigawatt buildout of Xe-100 SMRs, including an initial Washington state project.

articles.title: Google and Kairos Power team up for SMR deployments
articles.summary: Google agreed to buy power from future Kairos reactor projects, with a first deployment target of 2030 and an ambition for 500 MW by 2035.

articles.title: Commercial operation marks completion of Vogtle expansion
articles.summary: Georgia Power announced commercial operation at Vogtle unit 4, completing the two-reactor AP1000 expansion.

articles.title: Fourth Barakah unit connected to grid
articles.summary: The UAE's fourth Barakah reactor connected to the electricity grid, taking the complex closer to full commercial operation.

articles.title: Grid connection for Vogtle 4
articles.summary: Georgia Power's Vogtle 4 AP1000 began delivering electricity to the grid as part of start-up testing.
